description: Above-Table-5 heat load combined with a hot fuel-side inlet (paper Section 4.1 notes the fuel inlet temperature can climb to 381K in practice; this scenario pushes it further as a stress case) - threatens the anti-boiling supervisor margin (T_boil_limit - T_boil_margin = 493K) since the OHE's high effectiveness otherwise always pulls the tank temperature toward the fuel inlet temperature.
